mission_06: Use np.argpartition to find top-k indices efficiently: top_k_idx = np.argpartition(np.abs(flat), -k)[-k:]
For quantization: levels = 2^num_bits - 1. Quantized = round((update - min) / (max - min) * levels). Dequantize by reversing the mapping
Combine sparsification and quantization: first keep only top-k values, then quantize those values. This gives multiplicative compression: ratio * (num_bits/32)
